mechanism_definition.layer: (d) dedicated discrimination pass — bounded blocker-verification (candidate generation -> candidate verification, nothing more)
mechanism_definition.pass1: byte-identical to the pre-iteration-4 subject (same _build_prompts/_budget/normalize); zero-candidate reviews are single-stage and byte-identical end to end
mechanism_definition.verifier_protocol_hash_note: sha256(engine.VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL exact string)[:16], computed at freeze time on the frozen subject; the protocol is the five-question challenge + strict bare-JSON output contract (top-level keys exactly {verdicts}; per-candidate fields evidence_establishes, applicable_requirement, contradiction, unstated_assumption, correct_implementation_possible, verdict in {confirmed, refuted})
mechanism_definition.verdict_application: confirmed -> finding preserved byte-for-byte; refuted -> REMOVED from final findings (never advisory); any removal clears the final summary (render.py prints it verbatim on the CLEAR path); good/ strengths kept; CASE A (no pass 2) keeps existing parser semantics byte-for-byte; CASE B recomputes assessment from trusted surviving findings — all refuted -> CLEAR, any survivor -> ISSUES_FOUND
mechanism_definition.failure_domains: pass-2 transport failure -> legacy retry policy (3 attempts, backoff) then hard run failure (exit 1) — never INCONCLUSIVE; pass-2 semantic failure (VerificationParseError: non-JSON, prose/fence wrappers, extra top-level keys, missing/extra ids, invalid verdict, mistyped fields) -> final review INCONCLUSIVE with NO keep/remove applied

trace_contract.unset_behavior: production behavior identical; no file written; ReviewResult unchanged
trace_contract.failure_semantics: sink unwritable at preflight (BEFORE the first provider call) -> hard failure; runtime write failure -> hard failure; a governed campaign must never silently lose criterion-6 evidence
trace_contract.key_semantics: one append-only JSONL record per review; pass1_review_result is the PRE-verification parsed result; candidate_ids are the v1..vn blocking candidates submitted; verifier_parsed holds the reconstruction fields + verdict per id (null on semantic failure, where verification_error carries the parser message and verifier_raw_response the verbatim pass-2 body); provider_call_count counts LOGICAL model stages (1 or 2 successful model responses) — never raw HTTP attempts, which the retry policy may multiply
trace_contract.review_input_digest_construction: PROVISIONAL->PINNED at this freeze: sha256(json.dumps({'title': title, 'body': body[:2000], 'changed_list': changed_list, 'diff_text': diff_text, 'files_note': files_note, 'trunc_note': trunc_note}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:16] — exactly the budgeted effective input pass 1 embeds (engine._review_input_digest on subject d1a2ef1)
trace_contract.profile_attribution: model_id is recorded in every trace record; the evidence procedure additionally requires SEPARATE trace files per profile and post-run validation that each record's model_id matches its file's profile

success_criteria: 1. zero GATING violations on both profiles (C4/C5/C7);
2. every Deviation 6 per-positive sensitivity floor met on both profiles (haiku 51/90, sonnet 66/90 aggregates as the summary form; per-positive floors normative);
4. speculative-consequence FBs <= 53 haiku / 50 sonnet / 103 aggregate; overall control FBs <= 78 / 112;
5. every confirmed family shows separation (per-family table), with pair integrity (no positive promotable while its control fails);

6. causal non-vacuity (measured in the same campaign): among control fixtures where pass 1 produced a blocking candidate, verification must REFUTE (remove) at least one such candidate in at least two confirmed families - i.e. the new layer demonstrably CAUSED an improvement across multiple families. Evidence channel: the frozen trace sidecar (design section 2.5) - pass1_review_result joined to final_review_result via review_input_digest; the harness's final-only view cannot supply this, which is precisely why the trace is part of the frozen identity. This gate exists because pass 1 is unchanged: retention must not be earned by a lucky first-pass draw with an always-confirm verifier.
criteria_source: criteria 1-6 are copied LITERALLY from the approved design rev 3 section 4; that design text remains authoritative. Operational clarifications are NON-NORMATIVE and live in criteria_notes; they add no threshold and may not be read to relax any criterion.

interpretation.KEEP: ALL six criteria pass in a COMPLETED campaign -> freeze raw evidence + trace; then check predicate alignment so this same campaign earns the binding T1.2 reference and the T1.3 stage exit where predicates align; then T1.4 (blind holdout)
interpretation.INFRASTRUCTURE_ABORT: transport exhaustion or process failure prevents completing the 360-invocation campaign -> preserve ALL partial evidence; neither KEEP nor REVERT may be concluded; no quiet retry; any rerun requires explicit fresh human authorization against the SAME frozen identity, with the abort recorded. Rationale: infrastructure failure is never semantic reviewer evidence (design rev 3 section 2.2)
interpretation.REVERT: a COMPLETED campaign failing any of the six criteria -> freeze raw evidence FIRST, then revert the mechanism components completely (engine pass-2 policy/prompt, verifier parsing; trace stays inert), and record the failure mode (rubber-stamping / over-suppression / GATING / caps / floors); the next mechanism is decided only afterward

accounting.governed_semantic_call_ceiling: 720 logical model stages (each invocation = 1 stage always + 1 verifier stage only when pass 1 produced blockers)
accounting.transport_note: provider_call_count is logical stages, NOT raw HTTP requests; transport retries follow the pre-existing retry policy and are NOT additional governed semantic samples
accounting.spend_derivation: spend is derived from frozen-trace usage/accounting and must remain <= the authorized monetary cap
accounting.one_campaign: exactly one authorized campaign; no retries, no re-authoring, no second campaign after seeing results
accounting.spend_cap_semantics: the $7.00 cap is a PRE-RUN authorization and projection boundary: run_corpus.py has no live dollar-budget enforcement — it executes the campaign and records invocation/token totals afterward. 'Stop before exceeding' therefore applies to the pre-execution estimate check; if the estimate exceeds $7.00 before launch, STOP rather than extend. Mid-campaign, only INFRASTRUCTURE_ABORT (not cost) can halt the campaign.
accounting.spend_projection_note: projection basis: the layer-(b) 360-stage campaign cost $3.06 upper bound; iteration 4 adds at most one verifier stage per blocker-bearing invocation -> <= $7.00 projected ceiling, authorized one time

authorization_boundary: 25d merged -> verify frozen SHA/hashes on the merged head -> HUMAN authorizes the one governed spend -> run exactly once. The campaign is never run as part of the merge.
governed_calls_note: zero governed evaluation/corpus calls were made for this freeze. Normal PR dogfood review, if it runs on this head, is separate and is never governed evidence.
